# Copilot Proxy API

> Self-hosted proxy that exposes GitHub Copilot as an OpenAI-compatible and
> Anthropic-compatible API, so coding agents like Claude Code and Codex CLI can
> use a GitHub Copilot subscription as their model backend.

Unofficial, reverse-engineered, MIT-licensed. Not affiliated with GitHub. Runs
locally on port 4141 by default and requires an active Copilot subscription.

## What it does

- Serves `POST /v1/messages` (Anthropic Messages) — used by Claude Code.
- Serves `POST /v1/responses` (OpenAI Responses) — used by Codex CLI.
- Serves `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `GET /v1/models`, `POST /v1/embeddings`.
- Translates Anthropic requests to Copilot's format and back; the Responses
  route is a direct passthrough to Copilot's own Responses endpoint.

## Getting started with Claude Code

Run `npx copilot-proxy-api@latest start --claude-code`, complete GitHub device
sign-in, and select a primary and a small/fast model. The command prints a
launch command that sets `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4141/` and
`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` for Claude Code.

## Getting started with Codex CLI

Start the proxy with `npx copilot-proxy-api@latest start`, then add a custom
model provider to `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
model = "gpt-5.5"
model_provider = "copilot_proxy"
model_reasoning_effort = "high"

[model_providers.copilot_proxy]
name = "GitHub Copilot via copilot-proxy-api"
base_url = "http://localhost:4141/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
```

`base_url` must end in `/v1` — Codex appends `/responses` itself. Setting
`OPENAI_BASE_URL` alone does not work on recent Codex versions. Pick a model id
that your plan advertises at `GET /v1/models`.
